# Peak Dental Bend

> > Peak Dental Bend is a comprehensive dental practice in Bend, Oregon offering cosmetic, restorative, and preventive dentistry services led by Dr. Beau Kapp.

Peak Dental Bend serves Central Oregon with a full range of dental services from routine hygiene and emergency care to advanced cosmetic procedures like veneers and Botox. The practice emphasizes patient education through a blog and features modern diagnostic technology including CBCT imaging and digital X-rays.

## Cosmetic Dentistry Services

- [Veneers](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/veneers): Porcelain veneers for smile design and cosmetic improvements
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/teeth-whitening): Professional teeth whitening with Kör Whitening System
- [ABC Treatment](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/abc-treatment): ABC Treatment service: align, brighten, and contour teeth
- [Botox & Dermal Fillers](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/botox-dermal-fillers): Botox and dermal filler treatments for wrinkles and TMJ pain

## Restorative Dentistry Services

- [Dental Crowns](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/dental-crowns): Dental crowns and cap restorations for tooth protection
- [Ceramic Crowns](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/ceramic-crowns): All-ceramic and PFM crown options for esthetic restorations
- [Single Tooth Replacement](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/single-tooth-replacement): Single tooth replacement options including implants and bridges
- [Dental Bridges](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/dental-bridges): Dental bridges for replacing missing teeth solutions
- [White Fillings](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/white-fillings): Composite white fillings for tooth decay restoration

## Preventive Care & Diagnostics

- [Hygiene](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/hygiene): Routine cleanings and preventive dental hygiene services
- [Night Guards](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/night-guards): Night guards for bruxism, TMD, and jaw clenching treatment
- [CT Scans - CBCT](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/ct-and-cbct): CBCT imaging technology for implant planning and diagnostics
- [Digital X-Rays](https://www.peakdentalbend.com/services/digital-x-rays): Digital X-ray technology for efficient dental diagnostics
